0022600102.text: The Lakers, 1-0 and on a one-game winning streak, host the 1-0 LA Clippers in a regular-season game, with the Lakers sitting 2nd in the Pacific and 5th in the West while the Clippers are 1st in both. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the Lakers winning the most recent meeting 125-122 in Los Angeles on February 20, 2026. Lakers Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Jake LaRavia (ankle sprain) are out, while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery).
